title: Organizing Expo Projects
overview: A clean project structure helps maintain Expo applications as they grow and makes development easier.

example.title: Recommended Structure
example.content:
src/
 ├── components/
 ├── screens/
 ├── hooks/
 ├── services/
 └── utils/

title: Managing Dependencies
overview: Using compatible package versions and Expo recommended installation commands helps avoid build issues.

example.title: Dependency Management
example.content:
Use:
npx expo install package-name

Instead of manually choosing versions.

title: Handling Permissions Properly
overview: Applications should request permissions only when needed and handle denied permissions gracefully.

example.title: Permission Practice
example.content:
User Action
 ↓
Request Permission
 ↓
Allow / Deny
 ↓
Handle Result

title: Performance Optimization
overview: Optimizing components, images, and application logic improves Expo app performance.

example.title: Optimization Tips
example.content:
✔ Optimize images
✔ Use FlatList
✔ Avoid unnecessary renders
✔ Lazy load screens

title: Production Ready Expo Apps
overview: Production applications require proper testing, error handling, configuration, and build management.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned best practices for Expo project structure, dependencies, permissions, performance, and production releases.
